entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I have a lot to show you today!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Look! "Mental Training for Sports"![n]Oh, and "Building a Successful Business[n]from the Ground Up"!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I even have a book about the secret to[n]being a good listener! It was written by[n]a hostess from a club in Ginza.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Just picking out which books to bring[n]took me half a day. I have tons more[n]back home though!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've started using these as reference[n]materials for the advice I give to my[n]clients.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: This way, I can suggest new alternatives[n]instead of leaving them resigned to their[n]fates.
You're such a hard worker.[clr 27]
What about the divine power?
You must have lots of free time.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Of course.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: After all, I need to be able to advise my[n]clients on their future selves!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Ngh... You shouldn't make fun of me,[n]you know. That's a quick path to horrible[n]luck.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You'd think, wouldn't you?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But it's actually the complete opposite![n]I'm really busy!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Anyway, what I really want to tell you is[n]that I've arrived at a new fortune telling[n]philosophy.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Those with strong convictions can,[n]in fact, change fate. O-Oh, and as for[n]the people I sold Holy Stones to...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've started reading their fortunes[n]free of charge.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'd like to return the money they gave me[n]too, but um...
But what?
Did you spend it all?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: W-Well, um...

entries.speaker: Unassertive Man
entries.en: Am I interrupting?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yokoda-san!?

entries.speaker: Yokoda
entries.en: It's been a while, Maiden.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: U-Um, what are you doing here?

entries.speaker: Yokoda
entries.en: The chairman asked that I come see[n]how things are going.

entries.speaker: Yokoda
entries.en: Hm? And who are you?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Th-That's my apprentice! I haven't actually[n]introduced him to the chairman yet...

entries.speaker: Yokoda
entries.en: ...You're telling me you're so busy[n]you needed to hire an apprentice?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Y-Yes! He's been a wonderful help!

entries.speaker: Yokoda
entries.en: I see. I guess I should have expected[n]such great foresight from you, Maiden.

entries.speaker: Yokoda
entries.en: Now then, I should be going.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Th-Thank you for stopping by...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'm sorry you had to see that...
Who was he?
Maiden?
Are you in trouble?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Um, I suppose you could say he's...[n]an acquaintance.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: A-Anyway! It's a private matter,[n][lName]-san. Nothing you[n]should concern yourself with.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's, well... a nickname of sorts.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: A-Anyway! It's a private matter,[n][lName]-san. Nothing you[n]should concern yourself with.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: N-No, it's nothing serious.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: A-Anyway! It's a private matter,[n][lName]-san. Nothing you[n]should concern yourself with.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: W-Wait, are you perhaps... worried[n]about me?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, I'm so touched! Honestly!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My luck really improves when you're[n]around, [lName]-san!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I know! In return for that, I'll predict your[n]luck whenever you want!
I can sense Chihaya's[n]intense motivation...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My, it's already so late!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I should close up for today.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Good night, [lName]-san.
